text: Welcome. This is a short listening sample for your daily reading companion. Take a moment to settle in. The voice should feel warm and clear, with enough space between sentences to follow each word comfortably. You can listen for a few minutes, pause whenever you wish, and return to the same place later. This sample contains no hadith. It is simply a way to choose a narrator you would enjoy hearing each day.
instructions: Accent: neutral North American English. Voice: warm, natural, grounded, smooth and comfortable for sustained listening. Delivery: calm audiobook narration, around 145 words per minute, gentle sentence endings and natural pauses. Avoid theatrical delivery, whispering, exaggerated breathiness, and sharp or overemphasized consonants. Read the script exactly as written, without adding or omitting words.
review: User selected Cedar on 2026-10-16. No hadith narration approved or included.
